carpet.rule.stopFluidFlow.name: Stop Fluid Flow
carpet.rule.stopFluidFlow.desc: Prevents water and lava from spreading to new blocks.
carpet.rule.preventFluidInteraction.name: Prevent Fluid Interaction
carpet.rule.preventFluidInteraction.desc: Prevents fluids from reacting with world.
carpet.rule.preventFluidInteraction.extr: Prevents accidental stone generation from jamming flying machines.
carpet.rule.preventRailAutoConnection.de: Prevents rails from changing shape when a new rail is placed nearby.
carpet.rule.preventRailAutoConnection.ex: Useful for building dense parallel railways without them merging.
